calibration.selection: first and last distinct lexicographic core tuples, separately for scored and unscored cores
calibration.positive_endpoint: two consecutive transmissions of the originally counted exact composite identity
calibration.unscored_endpoint: any stable composite identity after two consecutive transmissions; descriptive coverage only
calibration.failure_action: complete frozen paired structural diagnostics; block benefit confirmation and retain beneficial yield unknown

score_registry: fixed union of exact isolation-confirmed composite identities from the five prepared states; aliases deduplicated
schedule_order: advance to time t, clear specified block at disturbance times, then detect and sample
score_samples: all 81 post-intervention samples at t=0,20,...,1600, equally weighted
strict_comparison: integer sums of scored-core counts over 162 samples per panel; exact ties fail
placement: rotate complete snapshot, center at (height//2,width//2) using rotated bounding dimensions; no phase advancement
analysis_unit: finite deterministic condition panels and nested selected core states, not independent histories
